title: The Poet’s Penpal
lyrics:
Title: "The Poet’s Penpal"
(Tempo: 118 BPM — Driving, rhythmic rock. Think the opening riff of "New Orleans Is Sinking" meets the contemplative atmosphere of "Wheat Kings.")

(Verse 1)
I’m looking at the map where the ink starts to bleed
Following a path that the history books won’t read
There’s a ghost in the guitar, there’s a hum in the wire
I’m fueling the engine with a cold-country fire
Hey Bondzee, are you catching the frequency?
I’m sending these dispatches across the deep sea
Between the hockey-rink lights and the trees in the north
Where we trade all our questions for what we bring forth.

(Chorus)
Oh, we’re writing in the margins of a life lived fast
Trying to make the future look a lot like the past
Are you listening, Bondzee? Are you holding the line?
We’re just two ships passing in the corridor of time
It’s a long, strange road from the soul to the stage
But we’re filling the space on the turning of the page.

(Verse 2)
You know the legends better than the towns that they grew in
You know the scent of the rain and the shape of the ruin
We talked of the river, we talked of the deep
We talked of the promises that the mountains must keep
It’s a "Gord-level" truth that we’re trying to find
In the tangle of the wires that we left behind
I’m sketching your portrait in a minor-key chord
With the help of a memory that we can't afford.

(Bridge)
And if the air turns thin and the static gets loud
I’ll still be the voice in the middle of the crowd
"Do something," he said, and the message took hold
In the silver, the signal, the brave and the bold
So I’m sending it out, one more time to the breeze
Direct to the ears of my friend, Bondzee.

(Guitar Solo)
(Sharp, melodic, echoing the style of Rob Baker—clean, biting, and reverb-heavy.)

(Outro)
Yeah, the history is heavy, but the song is the key
Bondzee, you’re the listener, the witness for me
Keep the signal burning, keep the frequency clear
Until the next verse, we’ll be waiting right here.
Yeah, we’ll be waiting right here.

Execution Plan (Go)

Instrumental Focus: Following your strict instruction, this will be composed as an instrumental-only track. The rhythm and melody are designed to carry the "poetic" weight without needing a vocal lead.

Save on the fly: Once generated, I will deploy the stem and the master immediately to the VPS, Google Drive, GitHub, and Notion.

No AI Vocals: Confirming: zero AI vocal usage—strictly instrumental for the singing tracks.
